seed.refused.message: {provider} refused the sign-in. Check the address and the {password}, then try again.
seed.refused.note: password: what the provider calls it (app password, app-specific password, password)

seed.refusedIMAP: {provider} refused the sign-in. Turn on IMAP access in {provider}'s settings, then try again.
seed.refusedMicrosoft: Microsoft refused the sign-in: Outlook.com and Microsoft 365 no longer accept passwords over IMAP. Connect with OAuth instead.

seed.unreachable.message: {host} didn't answer on port {port}. Check the server and try again.
seed.unreachable.note: host: an IMAP server such as imap.gmx.net

seed.blocked: {host} isn't an address ReputeCast may connect to.
seed.oauthOnly: {provider} seeds connect with OAuth or an app password.

seed.oauthNotSetUp.message: {app} sign-in isn't set up for this instance yet. An instance admin adds its client ID and secret in Instance admin › Authentication.

seed.oauthWrongAccount: {app} signed in as {email}, which isn't {expected}. Sign in with the seed's own account.
test.noSeeds: Add a seed mailbox first: each test sends one copy to each.
test.noConnectedSeeds: None of the chosen seeds is connected. Reconnect them, or pick others.
test.noContent: Pick what to test: a campaign, a template or a transactional template.
test.contentEmpty: {name} has no content yet. Write it in the composer first.
test.notPublished: {name} has no published version yet, so there's nothing to test.
test.noProviders: Pick a provider that can send this email.
test.noRoute: The {stream} route has no provider yet. Set one up in Routing, or test through one provider.

test.providerDown.message: {provider} is down, so it can't be tested now. It can be tested once it's healthy.

test.wrongStream: {provider} carries only its Transactional stream, so it can't send this campaign.
test.compareNeedsTwo: Comparing needs two providers that can send this email.
test.noSender: Pick a verified sender of the {stream} stream.
test.warmupCap: {provider} has {left, number} of today's {cap, number} warm-up messages left, and this test needs {needed, number}.
test.notWaiting: This test isn't waiting for copies any more.
test.copiesGone: The copies were already deleted from the seeds.

summary.provider.note: provider: a sending provider's short name (SES); result: its copies (Inbox 8 · Tab 2)

notify.finishedTitle.note: name: the test's name (Weekly Digest #142 · SES vs Postal)

notify.seedFailedBody: {provider} refused ReputeCast's sign-in. Tests skip this seed until it's reconnected.
notify.seedExpiredBody: {provider} ended ReputeCast's access. Reconnect it to keep testing it.
